cohort: 1,314 nulliparous women with early or full-term gestation and having no obstetric or medical contraindication to vaginal delivery who gave birth at an urban medical center between January 2017 and January 2020
finding: Primary cesarean delivery rates were significantly higher among nulliparous women who prefer languages other than English.
mod_finding: This study found that nulliparous women who preferred languages other than English had higher odds of undergoing cesarean delivery.
